records.jp: 亜子…ねえ、こないだ何があったの？
records.en_original: Ako, um... What happened the other day?
records.en_auxiliary: Ako, um... What happened the other day?
records.en: Ako, um... What happened the other day?

records.jp: ……妹ちゃん、学校でいじめられてたみたいなの
records.en_original: ...Eiko's little sister was being bullied at school.
records.en_auxiliary: Eiko's little sister was being bullied at school.
records.en: ...It seems Eiko-chan's younger sister was being bullied at school.

records.jp: えっ……
records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: What?!
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: 学校から怪我して帰ってきて英子ちゃんが理由を聞いて…<CR>それで初めて気づいたんだって
records.en_original: She came home from school injured, and Eiko asked her what happened... She said that's when she realized something.
records.en_auxiliary: She came home from school injured, and Eiko asked her what happened. She said that's when she realized something.
records.en: She came home from school injured, and Eiko-chan asked why...<CR>That's how Eiko-chan found out.

records.jp: 英子ちゃん、わたしのせいだって
records.en_original: Eiko says it's actually my fault.
records.en_auxiliary: Eiko says it's actually my fault.
records.en: Eiko-chan says it's actually my fault.

records.jp: なんでそれが亜子のせいになるの！？
records.en_original: How could it be your fault!?
records.en_auxiliary: How could it be your fault?!
records.en: How could it be your fault!?

records.jp: 妹ちゃん、わたしと友達だってクラスのみんなに<CR>言ってたみたいなの。でも、みんななかなか信じてくれなくて
records.en_original: Her little sister told her classmates that she's friends with me, but they wouldn't believe her.
records.en_auxiliary: Her little sister told her classmates that she's friends with me, but they wouldn't believe her.
records.en: Eiko-chan's younger sister told everyone in her class that she's friends with me,<CR>but they wouldn't believe her.

records.jp: だから妹ちゃん、わたしと一緒に写真を撮るんだって。<CR>でも、最近忙しくて全然会えなかったから……
records.en_original: So she told them she'd take a photo together with me. But I've been busy lately, I couldn't go see her...
records.en_auxiliary: So she told them she'd take a photo together with me. But I've been busy, so I haven't seen her lately.
records.en: So she said she'd take a picture with me.<CR>But I've been so busy lately that I couldn't see her...

records.jp: 嘘つきだって話になって。だから……
records.en_original: They started calling her a liar. And then the fights started...
records.en_auxiliary: They started calling her a liar. And then the fights started.
records.en: They decided she was a liar. And then...

records.jp: 何それ！　亜子、何も悪くないじゃない！
records.en_original: What!? You didn't do anything wrong, Ako!
records.en_auxiliary: What?! You didn't do anything wrong, Ako!
records.en: What!? You didn't do anything wrong, Ako!

records.jp: そんなことない！　わたしがいい気になってたから！
records.en_original: I did! I started getting self-centered!
records.en_auxiliary: I did! I've been so self-centered!
records.en: It is! I let it all go to my head!

records.jp: わたしがお金のことばっかりで、妹ちゃんが大変なことに<CR>なってたのに気付いてあげられなかったから……
records.en_original: I got so focused on money that I didn't even notice that Eiko's little sister was in trouble...
records.en_auxiliary: I got so focused on money that I didn't even notice that Eiko's little sister was in trouble.
records.en: I got so focused on money<CR>that I didn't even notice she was in trouble...

records.jp: 亜子……
records.en_original: Ako...
records.en_auxiliary: Ako...
records.en: Ako...

records.jp: わたしね、英子ちゃんに、<CR>妹ちゃんの事裏切ったって言われちゃった
records.en_original: Eiko told me that I stabbed her little sister in the back
records.en_auxiliary: Eiko told me that I stabbed her little sister in the back.
records.en: Eiko-chan told me<CR>I'd betrayed her younger sister.

records.jp: そんな……
records.en_original: You're kidding...
records.en_auxiliary: You're kidding...
records.en: You're kidding...

records.jp: お金のことしか考えてないって。<CR>だから……全部わたしが悪いの！
records.en_original: She said all I think about is money... That's why it's all my fault!
records.en_auxiliary: She said all I think about is money. That's why it's all my fault!
records.en: She said all I ever think about is money.<CR>So... this is all my fault!

records.jp: 亜子！！
records.en_original: Ako!!
records.en_auxiliary: Ako!
records.en: Ako!!

records.jp: 英子ちゃん！　亜子が……
records.en_original: Eiko! Ako just...
records.en_auxiliary: Eiko! Ako just...
records.en: Eiko-chan! Ako just...

records.jp: 話……聞いたの？
records.en_original: Did she tell you what happened?
records.en_auxiliary: Did she tell you what happened?
records.en: Did she tell you what happened?

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: 私……亜子に酷いこと言っちゃって……。<CR>妹の事でショックで、思ってもいないこと……
records.en_original: I...said some terrible things to Ako... I was so worried after what happened to my sister that I wasn't thinking...
records.en_auxiliary: I... said some terrible things to Ako. I was so worried after what happened to my sister that I wasn't thinking straight.
records.en: I... said something awful to Ako...<CR>I was so shocked about my sister that I said things I didn't even mean...

records.jp: 英子ちゃん……
records.en_original: Eiko...
records.en_auxiliary: Eiko...
records.en: Eiko-chan...

records.jp: 私、亜子探してくる！
records.en_original: I'll go look for Ako!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll go look for Ako!
records.en: I'll go look for Ako!

records.jp: 待って！　これ……亜子に渡して
records.en_original: Wait! ...Give this to her.
records.en_auxiliary: Wait! Give this to her.
records.en: Wait! ...Give this to her.

records.jp: ……手紙？
records.en_original: ...A letter?
records.en_auxiliary: ...A letter?
records.en: ...A letter?

records.jp: ……妹から。私からだと、<CR>受け取ってもらえるかどうか、わからないから
records.en_original: ...From my sister. I don't know if she'd accept anything from me, after all.
records.en_auxiliary: From my sister. I don't know if she'd accept anything from me.
records.en: ...It's from my sister. If it came from me,<CR>I don't know whether she'd take it.

records.jp: わかった
records.en_original: I got it.
records.en_auxiliary: I got it.
records.en: I got it.

records.jp: ……亜子！　やっと見つけた…
records.en_original: ...Ako! I finally found you...
records.en_auxiliary: Ako! I finally found you.
records.en: ...Ako! I finally found you...

records.jp: ……来ないで！
records.en_original: ...Don't come any closer!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't come any closer!
records.en: ...Don't come any closer!

records.jp: 亜子……
records.en_original: Ako...
records.en_auxiliary: Ako?
records.en: Ako...

records.jp: 来ないで！！　白井ちゃんには関係ないよ！！
records.en_original: No!! This has nothing to do with you, Shirai!!
records.en_auxiliary: No! This has nothing to do with you, Shirai!
records.en: No!! This has nothing to do with you, Shirai-chan!!

records.jp: 関係無いって、そんなことないよ。私にとって、<CR>亜子は大切な友達なの
records.en_original: Nothing to do with me? That's not true. You're an important friend to me, Ako.
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing to do with me? That's not true. You're an important friend to me, Ako.
records.en: What do you mean, nothing to do with me? That's not true.<CR>You're an important friend to me, Ako.

records.jp: わたしなんかと一緒にいたって、良いことなんかない！！
records.en_original: Nothing good will happen to anyone who gets close to me!!
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing good will happen to anyone who gets close to me!
records.en: Nothing good can come from being around someone like me!!

records.jp: 子供っぽいし、勉強もできないし、お金の事ばっかり考えてて、<CR>馬鹿な事するしかできなくて…妹ちゃんのことだって守れなくて…
records.en_original: I'm childish, and stupid, and only think about money, and only do idiotic things... I couldn't even protect a kid...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm childish, and stupid, and only think about money, and only do idiotic things. I couldn't even protect a kid.
records.en: I'm childish, I'm bad at school, and all I think about is money.<CR>All I can do is stupid things... I couldn't even protect her...

records.jp: ごめん……ごめんね……
records.en_original: I'm sorry... I'm sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry... I'm sorry...
records.en: I'm sorry... I'm sorry...

records.jp: 亜子！
records.en_original: Ako!
records.en_auxiliary: Ako!
records.en: Ako!

records.jp: ヒナちゃん！
records.en_original: Hina!
records.en_auxiliary: Hina!
records.en: Hina-chan!

records.jp: ユズ、ライム……私……
records.en_original: Yuzu, Lime... I...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu, Lime... I...
records.en: Yuzu, Lime... I...

records.jp: 落ち着いてヒナちゃん。<CR>まずは亜子ちゃんを助けましょう
records.en_original: Calm down, Hina. We're going to help Ako.
records.en_auxiliary: Calm down, Hina. We're going to help Ako.
records.en: Calm down, Hina-chan.<CR>First, let's help Ako-chan.

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Okay...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: それじゃ、行くよ！
records.en_original: Okay, let's go!
records.en_auxiliary: Let's get going!
records.en: Okay, let's go!
